details:
Updated Quotation Creation


  1. Specify a date (in dd-mm-yyyy format)


  1. Write specifications (predefined templates can be added)


  1. Pick Scopes


  1. Specify notes (if any), keep it blank to prevent rendering notes. You can also add to exclusions here


Quotation Template is rendered, you can do any modifications here.

Note: after this step you can NOT edit the template.




Updated Quotation Details

Now you can see the rendered template inside every quotation

details:
You can now add as many project images you want through the "Files" section inside every project.


When you upload an image file (png/jpg/jpeg) you can now pick "Project Image" as a tag.



After uploading, a new autoplay image slider will load in the overview page and cycles between all images





You still need to set a 'cover' photo for a project to be used in map and project cards

to set a cover photo for a project now you should CTRL + Click on the image hero section

details:
CTRL + Click on the project mini-map to view a larger version and set a location.


You can then set a location by double-clicking, dragging the pin or manually setting the longitude and latitude




Note: if you want to get coordinates through google maps, right click on the map

details:
You can now use the following combinations anywhere in the app to open the new issue dialog.

on desktop devices:

  • CTRL + ALT + SHIFT
  • ALT + H
  • ALT + I


on mobile devices:

  • Shake your device to open the new issue dialog.



From this dialog you can

  • Request a new feature
  • Report an issue/bug



Issue created here are directly linked to the dev server 🤓 so I don't forget anything.
